assumptions.choice: No entry, exit, stop-loss, or take-profit signals are generated by this strategy.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires schedule filtering but does not define the core strategy logic that creates trading signals.

assumptions.choice: NYSE-style full-day regular holidays are calculated algorithmically, including Good Friday and Juneteenth from 2022 onward.
assumptions.reason: No external calendar source is available; this supports historical and future arbitrary-date checks.

assumptions.choice: A forced Friday close is submitted when an open position exists on the last business day of the week.
assumptions.reason: With daily OHLCV data and normal Backtrader order execution, an order submitted in next() cannot be guaranteed to execute at that same day's end without a harness-level cheat-on-close configuration.
